correctness.rationale: Independent spheres in R³ give radial law r h/(4abc). For triangle lengths the overlap h is concave from 0 to U+c and h/r nonincreasing, yielding a nonnegative five-dimensional radial law r(h-rh′)/(12abc). The exact 5-to-3 projection integral recovers the normalized 3D law; the five-dimensional spectral hole precludes dimension six. For a nontriangle the three-dimensional spectral hole precludes dimension four. The analytic argument covers every positive real triple. Exact-rational checker confirms representative branches and moments without purporting to prove universal positivity.

value.rationale: A natural shell-sum closure geometry exactly controls a sharp jump in maximal radial positive-definite ambient dimension. The criterion includes all unequal triples, equality boundaries, an explicit nonnegative five-dimensional spectral distribution, and sharp impossibility at the next dimension; this is not an arbitrary finite slice or a mere equal-power reparameterization.
